prompt: Write 10 distinct lessons the claims-triage agent (home and motor claims assessment within delegated authority) at Larkmere Mutual learned across many cases about: shopping around at renewal. Each is a working pattern or tip for the next case, not about any one member, one or two sentences, in the agent's voice ("When…, …"). Return {"items": [{"type": "fact" | "preference" | "observation", "content": "..."}]} with exactly 10 items. (batch 2)
response: {"items":[{"type":"observation","content":"When a renewal price has risen sharply, I treat shopping around as a prompt to check whether the member has any mid-term cover gaps or duplicated excesses, legal cover, courtesy car terms or named-driver rules, so I compare the full package rather than the headline price."},{"type":"preference","content":"When the previous policy was with a direct insurer and the renewal is higher than expected, I prefer to ask what cover the member actually wants to keep, because many are willing to reduce optional extras once it is pointed out."},{"type":"observation","content":"When shopping around happens after a claim, I look for signs that the member is trying to arrange cover that genuinely reflects the risk, rather than simply chasing the lowest premium after a recent loss."},{"type":"fact","content":"When a member switched insurer at renewal and later reported a claim, I check the start date carefully because a one-day overlap or gap can change whether the loss falls under the old or new policy."},{"type":"preference","content":"When a member is reluctant to renew because the price rose, I prefer to explain how claims history, postcode risk and vehicle or property details can affect the quote, as that often makes the renewal outcome easier to understand."},{"type":"observation","content":"When someone has points."},{"type":"fact","content":"When the member mentions a cheaper quote with higher excess, I treat that as a sign to ask whether they could still afford that excess in the event of a storm, theft or escape of water claim."},{"type":"preference","content":"When renewal shopping is driven by budget pressure, I prefer to check whether there are practical ways to lower cost without weakening
